title: ShoppingListItem
description: A single line on the shopping list. PERSISTED so the list survives relaunch. Source of record: DinnerDecider/Models/ShoppingListItem.swift:9-27. On iOS this is a SwiftData @Model class, NOT Codable; this schema describes the persisted field set. Items arrive here either from an "almost there" recipe's missingItems or by manual entry. TODO(unresolved): canonical wire encoding for `dateAdded`, same caveat as inventory-item.schema.json.

name.description: Ingredient name as it will be shopped for. Deduplicated case-insensitively against the existing list before insertion, with the FIRST-SEEN casing preserved (ShoppingListLogic.aggregate / newItems, ShoppingListLogic.swift:9-28). Blank and whitespace-only names are dropped, never stored.

isChecked.description: Checked off in the UI. Drives the check-off and "clear checked" features, and the export marker.

dateAdded.description: When the line was added. Defaults to now.

isManual.description: True when the user typed this in by hand rather than adding it from a recipe.

$comment: Plain-text export format (ShoppingListLogic.exportText, ShoppingListLogic.swift:38-46) is part of the contract: header "Shopping List" then a blank line, then one line per item as "[x] Name" when checked and "[ ] Name" when not, and the whole string trimmed of trailing whitespace. An EMPTY list exports the exact string "Shopping List\n\n(empty)".
